title: THE GOLDEN SCOOTER'S FINAL SECRET! 🛵
topic: The ultimate upgrade to the midnight scooter

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: WHERE IS THE GOLDEN TURBO? [beat] I'VE BEEN TINKERING ON THIS PIECE OF TRASH FOR THIRTY DAYS STRAIGHT AND IT'S STILL NOT EVEN MOVING!

lines.speaker: riku
lines.text: Nix, you absolute idiot, [beat] that scooter isn't golden because of some magic paint, it's golden because you’ve been using the wrong grease for weeks!

lines.speaker: jamal
lines.text: Actually, I've been watching you on the security cameras [beat] sneaking out every single night at midnight like some kind of weird grease-covered monkey.

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: I wasn't stealing parts, Uncle Jamal! [beat] I was just borrowing the tools to fix those delivery bikes that keep breaking down in our messy alleyway.

lines.speaker: phupu
lines.text: Borrowing? More like wasting your life [beat] fixing things for people who don't even know your name while your own ride looks like a literal dumpster fire.

lines.speaker: mira
lines.text: It’s not a dumpster fire, Nix. [beat] We all saw you working through the rain last Tuesday to fix the pizza guy's flat tire without asking for a single dime.

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Who cares about a tire? [beat] This scooter was supposed to be my ticket to the championships, but it won't even start! I've totally failed the mission!

lines.speaker: jamal
lines.text: That's because the 'Ultimate Upgrade' isn't under that hood, kid. [beat] Check the storage locker under the main workbench in the garage right now.

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Wait... what is this? [beat] This isn't the old engine. This is a custom-built, titanium-grade hyper-drive with my name engraved right on the side!

lines.speaker: riku
lines.text: Every neighbor you helped [beat] pitched in their spare change and parts to build you the fastest scooter this city has ever seen. You actually earned this.

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: I can't believe it... [beat] I thought I was just being a loser doing community service while everyone else was getting ahead of me in the championship.

lines.speaker: mira
lines.text: Being a hero in the dark [beat] is the only reason you're standing next to a legend in the light today. Now get on that bike and win the trophy!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Nix realized the best upgrades come [beat] when you stop looking at the speedometer and start looking at the people you help when nobody is watching you.
